mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PRODUCT_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_TITLE, PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT_CONTENT, STATUS) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productTitle}, #{productName}, #{productContent}, 'ON_SALE')

SELECT SEQ_OPTION_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PRODUCTOPTION (OPTION_ID, OPTION_NAME, OPTION_PRICE, OPTION_STOCK) VALUES (#{optionId}, #{optionName}, #{price}, #{stock})

INSERT INTO CATEGORYDETAIL (CD_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PRODUCT_ID) VALUES (SEQ_CD_ID.NEXTVAL, #{categoryId}, #{productId})

SELECT SEQ_TAG_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TAG (TAG_ID, TAG_NAME, TAG_COLOR) VALUES (#{tagId}, #{tagName}, #{tagColor})
